newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: IMF approves 26.2 mln SDR credit for Azerbaijan.
newsitem.headline: IMF approves 26.2 mln SDR credit for Azerbaijan.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has approved a 26.2 million SDR loan for Azerbaijan, its resident representative said on Monday.

Tefik Yaprak told a news conference the IMF Board of Directors had approved a 21.5 million SDR tranche from the Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility (ESAF) and a 4.7 million SDR tranche from the Extended Financing Facility (EFF) to support structural reforms.
"Azerbaijan was able to speed up its structural reforms and has a good chance to become an advanced country," he said.
Yaprak said the IMF is satisfied with the pace of privatisation, the opening of voucher and cash auctions to sell off large- and medium-sized enterprises and continued banking sector reforms.
The tranches are part of a total 93.6 million SDRs in ESAF lending and 58.5 million SDRs in EFF lending planned by the IMF from 1996-99.
Azerbaijan has already received 172 million SDRs in lending from the IMF since gaining independence in 1992.
